name: button
title: Button
description: Triggers an action. Use one default button per view for the main action.
docs:
## Earth UI · Button guidelines

Import: `import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"`

### Choosing a variant
- `default`: the main action. Use at most one per view, dialog or card.
- `outline`: secondary actions next to a default button (Cancel, Export).
- `secondary`: low-emphasis actions that still need a filled shape.
- `ghost`: actions in toolbars, table rows and menus, where many actions repeat.
- `destructive`: irreversible actions (Delete, Cancel booking). Confirm them with an AlertDialog.
- `link`: inline actions inside text. To navigate, render a real link instead (see below).

### Sizes
- `default` for forms and dialogs, `sm` in dense UI such as tables and toolbars, `lg` for a page's main call to action, `xs` sparingly.
- Icon-only buttons use `icon`, `icon-xs`, `icon-sm` or `icon-lg` and must have an `aria-label`.

### Icons
- lucide-react only. Put `data-icon="inline-start"` or `data-icon="inline-end"` on the icon so padding adjusts.
- Don't set icon size classes; the button sizes icons itself.

### Navigation
- For a link that looks like a button: `<Button nativeButton={false} render={<a href="/book" />}>Book now</Button>`.
- Never wrap a Button in `<a>` or a Button in a Button.

### Text
- Use a verb plus an object in sentence case: "New appointment", "Save changes". Avoid "OK" and "Click here".
- Keep it to one line; buttons don't wrap.

### Don't
- Don't override colours, radius or height with `className`. The look comes from the theme variables.
- Don't put two default buttons side by side. Make one of them `outline`.
- Don't use `disabled` without explaining why nearby. Prefer validating on submit.
